title: Speculating
question: What do you think these people are doing?
note: Lines are said in order. A line with a card makes that card arrive the moment its phrase is spoken. The evidence in each line must match the photo: check before recording.

lines.text: Hmm, let's have a look at this picture.
Looking at the picture, there's every chance that they're working on something together. They're all looking at the same screen.

lines.rest: one of them is showing the others something.
lines.text: And it looks as if one of them is showing the others what she's done.

lines.rest: colleagues, or students on a project.
lines.text: They might be colleagues… or perhaps students on a project. I'm not sure.

lines.rest: the person standing is in charge.
lines.text: It's likely that the person standing behind them is in charge. They're watching quietly.
In all probability, they've found something interesting. They all look so focused!

lines.card: I am inclined to believe that …
lines.text: Actually, I'm inclined to believe that the news is good. Nobody looks worried at all.
So, what do you think they're doing?
